abstract: We examine how parental income and family structure during childhood and adolescence affect adult income, emphasizing the timing of these effects. Using an ordered multinomial probability model with functional covariates, we find that these familial influences are strongest in middle childhood and adolescence. We also uncover a complementary relationship in the effects of income and family structure trajectories during key developmental periods. By flexibly controlling for personal and family characteristics using nonparametric methods, our approach effectively handles high‐dimensional covariates. The results advance the understanding of intergenerational income mobility and highlight the long‐term importance of early‐life familial conditions for adult economic success.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了童年及青少年时期的父母收入与家庭结构如何影响成年后的收入水平，并重点分析了这些影响的时间节点。通过采用含函数协变量的有序多项概率模型，本研究发现这些家庭因素在童年中期及青少年时期的影响最为显著。同时，研究揭示了关键发育阶段中收入与家庭结构轨迹的互补效应。借助非参数方法灵活控制个人及家庭特征，本模型有效处理了高维协变量问题。研究结果深化了对代际收入流动性的理解，并凸显了早期家庭环境对成年后经济成就的长期重要性。
title: The Effects of Parental Income and Family Structure on Intergenerational Mobility: A Trajectories‐Based Approach
title_zh: 基于轨迹方法的父母收入与家庭结构对代际流动的影响

abstract: An adequate diet is essential for children’s cognitive, physical, and educational development, yet children from lower socioeconomic backgrounds are more likely to have poorer dietary quality, reinforcing social inequalities. This study examines whether the offer of school lunch can mitigate the effect of socioeconomic status on children’s total daily dietary quality. Using food frequency data from the second wave of the German KiGGS study (2014–2017), we construct an updated Healthy Nutrition Score for Kids and Youth (HuSKY) to capture overall dietary quality in a single measure. We focus on children between 6 and 13 years and proxy school lunch using attendance at after-school care facilities that typically offer school lunch. To address potential selection bias between children with and without such a lunch offer, we apply propensity score matching. We then estimate a mixed-effects model on the matched sample (n = 2,212) to analyze the effects of socioeconomic status, school lunch offer, and their interaction on total daily dietary quality. Our results corroborate that dietary quality is higher among children with higher socioeconomic status and is also positively associated with receiving a school lunch offer. Beyond supporting prior findings, we find that the positive association between socioeconomic status and dietary quality is substantially weaker among children receiving a school lunch offer. Accordingly, we conclude that school lunch may help reduce socioeconomic disparities in dietary quality. Future research should examine whether these improvements help reduce broader inequalities in health, education, and income. Policymakers should consider these potential benefits in the ongoing debate surrounding (free) school lunch provision.
abstract_zh: 充足的饮食对儿童的认知、身体及教育发展至关重要，然而社会经济背景较低的儿童往往饮食质量较差，这加剧了社会不平等。本研究探讨学校午餐供应是否能缓解社会经济地位对儿童每日总体饮食质量的影响。利用德国KiGGS研究第二波（2014-2017年）的食物频率数据，我们构建了更新版的儿童与青少年健康营养评分（HuSKY），以单一指标衡量整体饮食质量。研究对象为6至13岁的儿童，并以通常提供学校午餐的课后托管机构出勤情况作为学校午餐的代理变量。为处理有无此类午餐供应的儿童之间可能存在的选择偏差，我们采用倾向得分匹配方法。随后，在匹配样本（n=2,212）上估计混合效应模型，分析社会经济地位、学校午餐供应及其交互作用对每日总体饮食质量的影响。结果证实，社会经济地位较高的儿童饮食质量更高，且学校午餐供应与饮食质量呈正相关。在支持先前研究发现的基础上，我们发现，在接受学校午餐供应的儿童中，社会经济地位与饮食质量之间的正相关关系显著减弱。因此，我们得出结论：学校午餐可能有助于缩小饮食质量方面的社会经济差距。未来研究应探讨这些改善是否有助于减少健康、教育及收入方面的更广泛不平等。政策制定者在围绕（免费）学校午餐供应的持续讨论中，应考虑这些潜在益处。
title: Does school lunch equalize? An examination of dietary quality and socioeconomic disparities in Germany
title_zh: 学校午餐能否实现平等？德国膳食质量与社会经济差异的考察

abstract: We compare how well agents aggregate information in two repeated social learning environments. In the first setting agents have access to a public data set. In the second they have access to the same data, and also to the past actions of others. Despite the fact that actions contain no additional payoff-relevant information, and despite potential herd behavior, free riding and information overload issues, observing and imitating the actions of others leads agents to take the optimal action more often in the second setting. We also investigate the effect of group size, as well as a setting in which agents observe private data and others’ actions.
abstract_zh: 我们比较了两种重复社会学习环境中主体聚合信息的能力。在第一种环境中，主体可访问公共数据集。在第二种环境中，他们可访问相同的数据，以及他人过去的行为。尽管行为不包含额外的与收益相关的信息，且存在潜在的羊群行为、搭便车和信息过载问题，观察并模仿他人的行为使得主体在第二种环境中更频繁地采取最优行动。我们还研究了群体规模的影响，以及一种主体观察私人数据与他人行为的环境。
title: Learning through imitation: An experiment
title_zh: 通过模仿学习：一项实验

abstract: This analysis examines the prevalence of multiple jobholding, or moonlighting, for a cohort of relatively young workers over the past 20 years in the U.S. using National Longitudinal Survey of Youth (NLSY) data. The NLSY identifies every job held during each week over the period from 1999 to 2020. I compare those measures of multiple jobholding with the moonlighting experiences of an older cohort of NLSY workers in the U.S. who were born approximately a generation—20 years—earlier. The analysis explores the portion of the difference in the prevalence in multiple jobholding between the two cohorts due to demographic characteristics, educational attainment, and marital status over time.
journal: Oxford Bulletin of Economics and Statistics
title: Moonlighting: An Analysis of Multiple Jobholding

abstract: ABSTRACT Many countries conduct national assessments of educational performance, a type of standardised test that gives schools diagnostic feedback without having high stakes for students. We examine how publication of national assessment results at the school level affects primary school student outcomes. Using a policy reform in Japan that created a variation across municipalities in the level of aggregation at which the assessment results are disclosed, we show that disclosing school‐mean scores increased students' test scores by 0.12 standard deviations without compromising educational equity. The information disclosure worked as a catalyst to induce the schools to utilise the assessment's diagnostic feedback.
journal: Oxford Bulletin of Economics and Statistics
title: Should School‐Level Results of National Assessments Be Made Public? Evidence From a Policy Reform in Japan

abstract: Quantitative easing (QE) introduced during the 2008 financial crisis, has since remained a key monetary policy tool. Our paper studies how QE affects market liquidity using unique data on Swedish government bonds. We find that there is a deterioration in the level of market liquidity from QE. This scarcity effect is nonlinear. Only after QE reaches a certain volume level, it outweighs the improvement in liquidity from boosting market demand. Unlike market prices, which often react to announcements, liquidity does not change when QE is announced. Instead, the liquidity effect occurs in connection with the actual purchases.
abstract_zh: 2008年金融危机期间引入的量化宽松政策（QE）此后一直是重要的货币政策工具。本文利用瑞典政府债券的独特数据，研究量化宽松如何影响市场流动性。我们发现量化宽松会导致市场流动性水平恶化。这种稀缺效应是非线性的：只有当量化宽松达到一定规模后，其对流动性的负面影响才会超过通过提振市场需求带来的改善效应。与通常对政策公告做出反应的市场价格不同，流动性在量化宽松宣布时并未发生变化，而是与实际购买行为相关联时才产生流动性效应。
journal: Journal of Money, Credit and Banking
title: The Liquidity of the Government Bond Market—What Impact Does Quantitative Easing Have? Evidence from Sweden
title_zh: 政府债券市场的流动性——量化宽松有何影响？来自瑞典的证据

abstract: We show that carbon pricing and bank credit complement each other in reducing firms' carbon emission intensity. Our identification exploits a reform‐driven carbon price increase in the EU emission trading system (ETS) and administrative microdata, including the Italian credit registry. We find that highly exposed ETS firms increase term‐loan demand, relative to less exposed ETS firms. Such credit channel is associated with larger investment, but not with higher carbon emissions, reducing emission intensity. These effects are significant only among firms undertaking green investments. Moreover, higher credit demand by ETS firms crowds out credit supply to smaller firms in brown sectors.
abstract_zh: 我们证明，碳定价与银行信贷在降低企业碳排放强度方面具有互补作用。我们的识别策略利用了欧盟排放交易体系（ETS）改革驱动的碳价上涨以及包含意大利信贷登记系统的行政微观数据。研究发现，相较于受ETS影响较小的企业，受ETS影响较大的企业增加了定期贷款需求。这种信贷渠道与更大的投资规模相关，但并未导致碳排放增加，反而降低了排放强度。这些效应仅在进行绿色投资的企业中显著。此外，ETS企业信贷需求的增加挤出了对棕色行业中小企业的信贷供给。
journal: Journal of Money, Credit and Banking
title: Carbon Pricing, Credit Reallocation, and Real Effects
title_zh: 碳定价、信贷再配置与实际效应

abstract: This paper investigates how kinship and professional networks shaped labour market outcomes in the guild‐based labour market of early modern Genoa. Using a newly constructed dataset of more than 8,000 apprenticeship contracts (1451–1530), I examine the extent to which family and guild connections influenced apprentices' chances of attaining mastership. Using a probabilistic record‐linkage strategy to reconstruct individual career trajectories, I show that apprentices embedded in kinship or guild networks were substantially more likely to become masters. These advantages operated through multiple channels, including shorter apprenticeship contracts and greater flexibility in training careers, and persisted even during periods of economic contraction, suggesting that apprenticeship in Genoa combined formally open access to training with strong informal mechanisms that structured advancement within skilled trades. The findings contribute to debates on the role of guilds and social networks in pre‐industrial labour markets, highlighting how institutions could simultaneously support skill formation and reproduce inequality.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了在近代早期热那亚的行会劳动力市场中，亲属关系与职业网络如何塑造劳动力市场结果。利用新构建的包含8000余份学徒契约（1451–1530年）的数据集，我考察了家庭与行会关系对学徒获得师傅资格的影响程度。通过采用概率性记录关联策略重建个体职业轨迹，我发现嵌入亲属或行会网络的学徒成为师傅的可能性显著更高。这些优势通过多种渠道发挥作用，包括更短的学徒契约期限和更灵活的职业培训路径，并且即使在经济收缩时期依然持续存在。这表明热那亚的学徒制度将正式开放的培训准入与塑造技能行业晋升路径的强有力非正式机制相结合。研究结论为关于前工业劳动力市场中行会与社会网络作用的讨论提供了新视角，揭示了制度如何同时支持技能形成并再生产不平等。
title: Networks paving the way: Apprenticeship, guilds, and access to mastership in early modern Genoa
title_zh: 网络铺路：近代早期热那亚的学徒制、行会与匠师资格获取

abstract: In 2018, two compensating‐income variation studies, based on Household, Income and Labour Dynamics in Australia, reported sharply different monetary health values: A$42,000–A$67,000 for a full quality‐adjusted life year (QALY) gain versus A$162,000 for a 0.10 QALY loss (implying A$1.6 million per QALY under linear scaling). We embark on econometric detective work to identify the sources of these discrepancies, carefully aligning samples, cross‐examining methodologies, and uncovering methodological differences that drive the divergent results. Gain–loss framing is the largest margin (consistent with willingness‐to‐accept/willingness‐to‐pay evidence), while estimator choice (instrumental variables versus reduced form) and income equivalization further magnify differences, jointly resulting in the order‐of‐magnitude gaps with implications beyond health.
abstract_zh: 2018年，两项基于澳大利亚家庭、收入与劳动动态调查的补偿性收入变化研究，报告了截然不同的货币化健康价值：完全质量调整生命年（QALY）增益为42,000–67,000澳元，而0.10 QALY损失则为162,000澳元（在线性缩放下相当于每QALY 160万澳元）。我们展开计量经济学侦探工作，以识别这些差异的来源，仔细对齐样本、交叉检验方法论，并揭示导致结果分歧的方法论差异。得失框架是最大的差异来源（与意愿接受/意愿支付证据一致），而估计量选择（工具变量与简化形式）及收入等值化进一步放大了差异，共同导致了数量级上的差距，其影响超越了健康领域。
title: Following the money: an econometric investigation into health valuations
title_zh: 追踪资金流向：健康价值评估的计量经济学研究

abstract: Market integration is critical for food security in developing economies facing socio-political instability. Using weekly price data from ninety-seven Nigerian markets, this study investigates how violent conflict influences price dynamics between market pairs. Results reveal that frequent violent events have limited short-term effects on price transmission, and changes in conflict intensity do not significantly disrupt price adjustments. Markets with stronger trade connections demonstrate greater resilience by leveraging alternative trade routes. These findings highlight the role of market connectivity in maintaining trade efficiency, suggesting that policies that enhance market networks can strengthen resilience and improve food security.
abstract_zh: 市场整合对于面临社会政治动荡的发展中经济体的粮食安全至关重要。本研究利用尼日利亚97个市场的周度价格数据，考察暴力冲突如何影响市场对之间的价格动态。结果显示，频繁的暴力事件对价格传导的短期影响有限，冲突强度的变化并未显著干扰价格调整。贸易联系较强的市场通过利用替代贸易路线展现出更强的韧性。这些发现凸显了市场连通性在维持贸易效率中的作用，表明增强市场网络的政策能够强化韧性并改善粮食安全。
title: Market integration and the impact of violence on trade networks: Evidence from Nigeria
title_zh: 市场整合与暴力对贸易网络的影响：来自尼日利亚的证据

abstract: This paper evaluates a multifaceted female empowerment program in urban Liberia that combined intensive psychosocial therapy with vocational skills training over 12 months. The evaluation uses a randomized controlled trial with follow-up surveys at 1 year and 3.5 years post-program (2 and 4.5 years after enrollment). At the first endline, treatment women experienced large reductions in emotional and physical/sexual intimate partner violence (IPV) and in perceived community norms supporting IPV; effects on psychological well-being were null. By 3.5 years, the treatment group’s IPV levels remained close to their first-endline values, but the treatment–control difference had closed because the control group also experienced substantial reductions. Only the gap in perceived community norms persisted. Qualitative evidence points to the psychosocial component as the primary active ingredient, while the economic arm was operationally compromised by the non-delivery of promised capital grants. We interpret the longer-term convergence as durable individual- and interpersonal-level change for treatment women, set against contemporaneous structural interventions in the study region that plausibly affected the control group in particular.
abstract_zh: 本文评估了利比里亚城市地区一项多维度女性赋权项目，该项目在12个月内将强化心理社会治疗与职业技能培训相结合。评估采用随机对照试验设计，并在项目结束后1年及3.5年（即入组后2年及4.5年）进行跟踪调查。在首次终期调查中，接受干预的女性在情感及身体/性亲密伴侣暴力（IPV）方面显著减少，且其对支持IPV的社区规范的感知也有所下降；但心理幸福感方面的效果不显著。至3.5年时，干预组的IPV水平仍接近首次终期调查时的数值，但由于对照组也经历了大幅下降，干预组与对照组之间的差异已消失。仅在对社区规范的感知差距上得以持续。质性证据表明，心理社会干预是主要有效成分，而经济干预因承诺的资本赠款未予发放而在操作上受到损害。我们将长期趋同解释为干预组女性在个体及人际层面发生的持久变化，而同期研究区域内影响对照组的结构性干预措施可能尤为相关。
title: Temporary acceleration or long-term change? Experimental evidence on female empowerment and intimate partner violence in urban Liberia
title_zh: 暂时加速还是长期变革？利比里亚城市地区女性赋权与亲密伴侣暴力的实验证据

abstract: Much economic analysis derives policy recommendations based on social welfare criteria intended to model policymakers’ preferences. Yet, little is known about policymakers’ normative views suitable for this use. Our behavioural experiment elicits German legislators’ welfare criteria. When resolving preference conflicts across individuals, they place substantially more importance on least-favoured alternatives than on most-favoured alternatives, contrasting with common aggregation mechanisms and the equal weighting inherent in utilitarianism. When resolving preference conflicts within individuals, politicians choose inconsistently with behavioural economists’ most common approach to welfare analysis with time-inconsistent preferences. In distribution, politicians largely support the same welfare criteria as the public.
abstract_zh: 许多经济分析基于社会福利标准推导政策建议，旨在模拟政策制定者的偏好。然而，关于适合此用途的政策制定者规范观点，我们知之甚少。我们的行为实验揭示了德国立法者的福利标准。在解决个体间的偏好冲突时，他们赋予最不利选项的重要性远高于最有利选项，这与常见的聚合机制及功利主义中固有的平等加权形成对比。在解决个体内部的偏好冲突时，政治家的选择与行为经济学家在时间不一致偏好福利分析中最常用的方法不一致。在分配问题上，政治家与公众所支持的福利标准基本一致。
title: Politicians’ Social Welfare Criteria An Experiment With German Legislators
title_zh: 德国立法者政治家的社会福利标准实验

abstract: Despite the increasing importance of multiple priors in various domains of economics, choice-based incentive-compatible multiple-prior elicitation remains an open problem. This paper develops a solution, comprising a preference-based identification of a subject’s probability interval for an event, and a method for eliciting it. The method applies under weak decision-theoretic assumptions, with no need for probabilistic sophistication. To demonstrate its feasibility, we implement it in three incentivized experiments on artificial and natural sources of uncertainty. Intervals elicited by our method are sensitive to the direction and amount of information and are typically consistent with “objective” probabilities where available. We find a predominance of non-degenerate probability intervals, with intervals being wider when there is less information or predictability. The probability intervals elicited with our method are similar to those stated by subjects on aggregate, suggesting that the method can provide behavioural foundations for the use of stated probability-interval techniques in the field.
abstract_zh: 尽管多重先验在经济学各领域的重要性日益凸显，基于选择的激励相容多重先验启发仍是一个未解难题。本文提出一套解决方案，包含基于偏好的个体事件概率区间识别方法及其启发技术。该方法在弱决策理论假设下适用，无需概率精炼性假设。为验证可行性，我们针对人工与自然不确定性来源开展三项激励实验。实验表明：该方法启发的概率区间对信息方向与信息量敏感，且在存在客观概率时通常与之吻合。我们发现非退化概率区间占主导地位，当信息量较少或可预测性较低时区间宽度更大。该方法启发的概率区间与受试者整体陈述的区间相似，表明该技术可为实地研究中陈述概率区间方法提供行为基础。
title: Eliciting Multiple Prior Beliefs
title_zh: 引出多重先验信念

abstract: We document dramatic changes in euro area interbank money markets during the financial and sovereign debt crises: unsecured borrowing declined across the euro area, while secured market haircuts on sovereign bonds increased, and bank borrowing from the European Central Bank rose in southern countries. We construct a quantitative general equilibrium model to assess the macroeconomic impact of these developments and the associated policy response. Our model features heterogeneous banks and sovereign bonds, secured and unsecured money markets, and a central bank. We compare a benchmark policy—the central bank providing collateralized lending to banks at haircuts lower than the market—with an alternative policy that maintains a constant central bank balance sheet. We show that the fall in output, investment, and capital would have been twice as high under the alternative policy.
abstract_zh: 本文记录了欧元区银行间货币市场在金融危机和主权债务危机期间的剧烈变化：欧元区无担保借贷普遍下降，主权债券的担保市场折扣率上升，而南部国家银行从欧洲中央银行的借款增加。我们构建了一个定量一般均衡模型，以评估这些变化及其相关政策应对的宏观经济影响。该模型包含异质性银行与主权债券、有担保与无担保货币市场，以及中央银行。我们将基准政策——中央银行以低于市场的折扣率向银行提供抵押贷款——与维持中央银行资产负债表不变的替代政策进行比较。研究表明，在替代政策下，产出、投资和资本的下降幅度将是基准政策的两倍。
title: Money Markets, Collateral, and Monetary Policy
title_zh: 货币市场、抵押品与货币政策

abstract: This paper studies the long-term effects of technology and know-how transfers on structural transformations. In the 1950s, the Soviet Union supported the construction of the 156 Projects, which were large-scale, capital-intensive industrial clusters in China. These projects included a technology transfer, consisting of state-of-the-art Soviet machinery and equipment, and a know-how transfer, via the training of Chinese engineers, production supervisors, and high-skilled technicians by Soviet experts. We use newly assembled data that follow steel plants for over four decades, and we exploit natural variation in the transfers they eventually received. We find that, while production advantages stemming from Soviet technology faded away if not complemented with training, the know-how transfer had a long-lasting impact on plant performance, stimulated technology upgrade when China was a closed economy, and increased exports to the Western world when China engaged in international trade. The know-how transfer also generated productivity and technology spillovers onto complementary establishments.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了技术与知识转移对结构转型的长期影响。20世纪50年代，苏联援建了156项工程，这些工程是中国境内大规模、资本密集型的工业集群。这些项目包含技术转移（通过提供苏联最先进的机械设备）和知识转移（通过苏联专家培训中国工程师、生产主管及高级技工）。我们利用新汇编的跨越四十余年的钢铁厂数据，并借助这些工厂最终获得转移项目的自然差异进行分析。研究发现：若缺乏配套培训，源自苏联技术的生产优势会逐渐消退；而知识转移对工厂绩效具有持久影响，在中国封闭经济时期推动了技术升级，并在中国融入国际贸易后增加了对西方世界的出口。此外，知识转移还对配套企业产生了生产率与技术溢出效应。
china_relevance_reason: 标题、摘要或元数据包含中国相关关键词
title: Technology Transfer and Early Industrial Development: Evidence from the Sino-Soviet Alliance
title_zh: 技术转移与早期工业发展：来自中苏联盟的证据

abstract: This paper develops a set of empirically tractable and flexible sieve estimators for semi-nonparametric multidimensional matching models with transferable utility, focusing on worker-job matching. We generalize the parametric quadratic-Gaussian framework employed by Bojilov and Galichon (2016) and Lindenlaub (2017), which relies on joint normality of observed characteristics. We allow unrestricted distributions of characteristics and show identification of the production technology and the equilibrium wage and matching functions using optimal transport theory. Given identification, we propose efficient, consistent, and asymptotically normal sieve estimators. We revisit Lindenlaub’s empirical application and show that, between 1990 and 2010, the U.S. economy experienced much larger technological progress favoring cognitive abilities than the original findings suggest. Furthermore, our flexible model specifications provide a significantly better fit for patterns in the evolution of wage inequality.
abstract_zh: 本文构建了一套经验上易于处理且灵活的筛子估计量，用于具有可转移效用的半非参数多维匹配模型，重点关注工人-职位匹配。我们推广了Bojilov和Galichon（2016）及Lindenlaub（2017）所采用的参数二次高斯框架，该框架依赖于观测特征的联合正态性。我们允许特征分布不受限制，并利用最优传输理论证明了生产技术以及均衡工资和匹配函数的可识别性。在识别的基础上，我们提出了高效、一致且渐近正态的筛子估计量。我们重新审视了Lindenlaub的实证应用，并表明在1990年至2010年间，美国经济经历了比原始发现所暗示的更为显著的技术进步，偏向于认知能力。此外，我们灵活的模型设定为工资不平等演变模式提供了显著更好的拟合。
source_issue: Journal of Econometrics, Volume 256, Part A
title: Semi-nonparametric models of multidimensional matching: An optimal transport approach
title_zh: 多维匹配的半非参数模型：一种最优传输方法

abstract: The global energy transition is accelerating the phase-out of fossil fuel combustion, yet its indirect environmental benefits through reduced fossil fuel extraction remain underexplored. This paper examines whether coal mining-induced deforestation and air pollution emissions are smaller in regions with greater renewable energy deployment in China. Leveraging high-resolution geographical data on permitted coal mining areas, along with satellite data on forest cover and PM2.5 emissions in the past two decades, we find that while coal mining reduces forest cover by 3.3%, integrating an additional 1% of local renewable energy into the electricity grid is associated with about 0.3% lower deforestation. As PM2.5 is transported downwind, ambient pollution and benefits of renewables have spillover to counties within 30 km of coal mines. Monetizing these benefits of avoided deforestation and air pollution, we estimate that the total value can exceed one billion US dollars. Our findings offer policy insights to promote energy transition with ecological preservation and environmental protection.
abstract_zh: 全球能源转型正加速化石燃料燃烧的淘汰进程，然而，通过减少化石燃料开采所带来的间接环境效益仍未得到充分探讨。本文考察了中国可再生能源部署较多的地区，其煤炭开采引发的森林砍伐和空气污染排放是否相对较少。利用过去二十年中关于许可煤矿区的高分辨率地理数据，以及卫星获取的森林覆盖和PM2.5排放数据，我们发现，尽管煤炭开采使森林覆盖率减少了3.3%，但当地电网中每增加1%的可再生能源，与约0.3%的森林砍伐减少相关联。由于PM2.5随风向下风向传输，环境中的污染及可再生能源的效益会溢出至煤矿周边30公里内的县区。将这些避免的森林砍伐和空气污染所带来的效益货币化后，我们估计其总价值可超过十亿美元。我们的研究为促进能源转型与生态保护及环境保护协同推进提供了政策启示。

journal: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
source_issue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management, Volume 139
title: Environmental benefits of renewable energy: Evidence from coal mining-induced deforestation and air pollution emissions
title_zh: 可再生能源的环境效益：来自煤炭开采导致森林砍伐和空气污染排放的证据

abstract: Financial constraints are one of the most severe obstacles for the operation and development of small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs), especially in low- and middle-income countries (LMICs). Yet women and women-led enterprises are disproportionally affected, which leads to a gender gap in access to finance. This paper uses panel estimation techniques, namely a correlated random effects model, for 1,655 financial institutions from 109 mostly LMICs for the years 2000 to 2019 to examine empirically whether there are purely economic incentives for financial institutions to scale up their lending activities towards women and women-led enterprises. Going beyond the microfinance sector, this study provides – to the best of my knowledge – the first empirical evidence on this question for banks and bank-like financial institutions that serve higher credit market segments. I find positive and significant effects on the quality of the loan portfolio (lower portfolio at risk), income streams (higher portfolio yield) and the overall financial performance (captured by return on assets or profit margin). Since economic incentives and profitability considerations are crucial in steering the decisions of financial institutions with regard to credit allocations, the banks’ self-interest could lead to management decisions and internal directives to favor female loan applicants, which could contribute to closing the gender gap in access to finance. Furthermore, the findings on the positive effects on banks’ financial performance give policymakers and regulators leeway to push financial institutions through more restrictive policy measures and regulatory requirements to direct more loans to women and women-led firms.
abstract_zh: 融资约束是中小企业（SMEs）运营与发展面临的最严重障碍之一，尤其是在中低收入国家（LMICs）。然而，女性及其领导的企业受到的影响尤为严重，这导致了融资获取方面的性别差距。本文采用面板估计技术，即相关随机效应模型，对来自109个主要为中低收入国家的1,655家金融机构在2000年至2019年间的数据进行了实证分析，以探讨金融机构扩大对女性和女性领导企业的贷款活动是否存在纯粹的经济激励。超越小额信贷领域，本研究——据我所知——首次为服务于更高信贷市场细分领域的银行及类似银行金融机构提供了关于这一问题的实证证据。我发现，贷款组合质量（组合风险降低）、收入流（组合收益率提高）以及整体财务绩效（以资产回报率或利润率衡量）均呈现出积极且显著的影响。由于经济激励和盈利性考量在引导金融机构信贷分配决策中至关重要，银行的自利动机可能促使管理层决策和内部指令倾向于女性贷款申请人，这有助于缩小融资获取方面的性别差距。此外，关于银行财务绩效积极影响的研究发现，为政策制定者和监管机构提供了空间，通过更具限制性的政策措施和监管要求，推动金融机构将更多贷款导向女性和女性领导的企业。
title: Is there a business case for banks to increase lending to women and women-led firms? Cross-country evidence on financial performance
title_zh: 银行增加对女性和女性领导企业贷款的商业理由是否存在？跨国财务绩效证据

abstract: We study the consequences of a large-scale reassessment of the health and working capacity of disability insurance beneficiaries in Hungary. Leveraging birthday and health cutoffs in the reassessment, we estimate employment responses to the threat of disability benefit loss and the actual termination or reduction of benefits. We show that due to the threat of benefit removal, many beneficiaries stopped working after the reassessment was announced but before it took place. Another group of beneficiaries lost their benefits and increased their labor supply significantly. Overall, the reassessment had a negative short-term and neutral medium-term impact on employment and earnings. Our results suggest that unintended responses to the threat of benefit loss operate as a substitution effect that can reduce labor supply even without binding formal earnings limits, and thus should be considered in the design of reassessments.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了匈牙利对残疾保险受益人健康及工作能力的大规模重新评估所带来的后果。利用重新评估中的生日和健康临界点，我们估计了就业对残疾福利丧失威胁及实际终止或减少福利的反应。结果显示，由于福利取消的威胁，许多受益人在重新评估宣布后但实施前便停止了工作。另一部分受益人则失去了福利，并显著增加了劳动供给。总体而言，重新评估对就业和收入产生了短期负面及中期中性的影响。我们的研究结果表明，对福利丧失威胁的非预期反应作为一种替代效应，即便在没有正式收入限制的情况下也能减少劳动供给，因此在设计重新评估时应予以考虑。
title: The employment effects of disability benefit reassessment
title_zh: 残疾津贴重新评估的就业效应

abstract: This paper examines the levels and dynamics of wealth inequality in Chile between 2007 and 2021, in a context where the private pension system is mandatory and government housing policies are centered on private ownership. We focus on two major macroeconomic events: the sharp increase in housing prices following the introduction of a value-added tax on new dwellings in 2016 and the large-scale liquidation of pension assets through early withdrawals during the recent pandemic. To do so, we construct a micro–macro consistent wealth distribution by extending existing methodologies to integrate administrative pension fund balances into household wealth surveys using machine learning techniques. Our results reveal pronounced wealth concentration: the top 1% hold roughly one-third of total private wealth—levels comparable to those observed in the United States—driven by their disproportionate ownership of financial assets. By contrast, the bottom 50% hold 7–9%, primarily through housing and pension assets, shares that exceed those reported in most European countries. We also document a modest decline in wealth inequality over the period, particularly after 2016. A counterfactual analysis suggests that this decline reflects the interaction of two opposing forces: housing appreciation, which predominantly benefited the bottom 90% of households, and pension withdrawals, which reduced wealth across the distribution while relatively increasing inequality. Our findings on levels, trends, and counterfactuals are robust across alternative methodological specifications.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了2007年至2021年间智利财富不平等的水平与动态变化，其背景是私人养老金制度为强制性，且政府住房政策以私人所有权为核心。我们重点关注两大宏观经济事件：2016年对新住宅征收增值税后房价的急剧上涨，以及近期疫情期间通过提前提取养老金资产进行的大规模清算。为此，我们通过扩展现有方法，利用机器学习技术将行政养老金账户余额整合至家庭财富调查中，构建了一个微观与宏观一致的财富分布。研究结果显示，财富集中程度显著：前1%的家庭持有约三分之一的私人总财富，这一水平与美国相当，主要得益于其对金融资产的不成比例持有。相比之下，底层50%的家庭持有7%至9%的财富，主要来源于住房和养老金资产，这一比例高于大多数欧洲国家的报告值。我们还记录了该时期内财富不平等的温和下降，尤其是在2016年之后。反事实分析表明，这一下降反映了两种相反力量的相互作用：住房升值主要惠及底层90%的家庭，而养老金提取则减少了各阶层的财富，同时相对加剧了不平等。我们的研究结果在水平、趋势及反事实分析方面，均在不同方法论设定下保持稳健。
title: From housing gains to pension losses: Micro-macro integration to reveal wealth inequality dynamics in Chile
title_zh: 从住房收益到养老金损失：微观-宏观整合揭示智利财富不平等动态

abstract: By embedding uncertainty into time, we obtain a conjoint axiomatic characterization of both Exponential Discounting and Subjective Expected Utility that accommodates arbitrary state and outcome spaces. In doing so, we provide a novel and simple time-interpretation of subjective probability. The subjective probability of an event is calibrated using time discounting.
abstract_zh: 通过将不确定性嵌入时间之中，我们获得了指数贴现与主观期望效用的一种联合公理化刻画，该刻画适用于任意状态空间和结果空间。在此过程中，我们为主观概率提供了一种新颖且简洁的时间解释。事件的主观概率通过时间贴现进行校准。
title: Discounted Subjective Expected Utility in continuous time
title_zh: 连续时间下的折现主观期望效用

abstract: This paper explores the impact of international experience on worker mobility, with a focus on Swedish companies acquired by foreign multinationals. We posit that international experience, by imparting knowledge about foreign operations, enhances an employee’s appeal to multinational enterprises (MNEs). By matching acquired firms with comparable control firms and using a stacked difference-in-differences methodology, we observe a significant impact of foreign acquisitions on job mobility. Our results indicate that foreign acquisitions raise the likelihood of switching to another MNE by 3.6 percentage points, while reducing moves to local firms by approximately 4 percentage points. Furthermore, workers who transition to another MNE post-acquisition have significantly higher wage growth compared to those who stay. Additional analyses reveal that the positive effect on mobility to MNEs is linked to learning opportunities stemming from increased trade linkages within multinational production networks and the implementation of advanced technologies after an acquisition.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了国际经验对劳动力流动性的影响，重点关注被外国跨国公司收购的瑞典企业。我们假设，国际经验通过传授关于外国运营的知识，增强了员工对跨国企业（MNEs）的吸引力。通过将收购企业与可比对照组企业进行匹配，并采用堆叠双重差分法，我们观察到外国收购对职业流动性有显著影响。结果显示，外国收购使员工转向另一家跨国企业的可能性提高了3.6个百分点，而转向本地企业的概率则降低了约4个百分点。此外，收购后转至其他跨国企业的员工，其工资增长显著高于留在原企业的员工。进一步分析表明，对跨国企业流动性的积极影响与学习机会相关，这些机会源于跨国生产网络内贸易联系的增强以及收购后先进技术的实施。
title: From local to global: How foreign acquisitions reshape job mobility
title_zh: 从本土到全球：外资并购如何重塑职业流动性

abstract: This paper examines whether the energy transition supports tax revenue mobilization in developing countries. Using a newly constructed Multidimensional Energy Development Index and a panel of 52 developing economies over the period 2000–2019, we analyze the relationship between the energy transition and tax revenue aggregates—including total, direct, indirect, and trade taxes—as well as fiscal effort. Results show a statistically significant and economically meaningful positive relationship between the energy transition and all tax revenue components. Further analysis suggests that this relationship operates through improved energy access, higher economic activity, productivity gains, and enhanced human development. These findings challenge concerns about potential fiscal burdens associated with the energy transition, indicating that green energy–oriented policies can strengthen fiscal sustainability in low- and middle-income countries and support inclusive energy and environmental tax reforms. Finally, we propose policy recommendations aimed at helping decision-makers in these countries reconcile environmental and budgetary challenges.
abstract_zh: 本文考察能源转型是否有助于发展中国家调动税收收入。利用新构建的多维能源发展指数以及2000年至2019年间52个发展中经济体的面板数据，我们分析了能源转型与税收收入总量——包括总税收、直接税、间接税和贸易税——以及财政努力之间的关系。结果显示，能源转型与所有税收收入组成部分之间存在统计上显著且经济意义重大的正相关关系。进一步分析表明，这种关系通过改善能源获取、提高经济活动水平、提升生产率以及促进人类发展来实现。这些发现对能源转型可能带来财政负担的担忧提出了质疑，表明绿色能源导向型政策能够增强低收入和中等收入国家的财政可持续性，并支持包容性的能源与环境税收改革。最后，我们提出政策建议，旨在帮助这些国家的决策者协调环境与预算挑战。
publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
title: Can energy transition strengthen tax revenue mobilization in developing countries? Empirical evidence and policy implications
title_zh: 能源转型能否增强发展中国家的税收动员能力？实证证据与政策启示

abstract: We provide quasi-experimental evidence of the effects of municipal budget rules on the level of local economic activity exploiting the fact that, in 1999, the Italian government imposed a balanced-budget fiscal rule on all municipal governments but in 2001 exempted municipalities below 5,000 inhabitants. Municipalities which remained subject to budget rules increased taxes but also experienced a significant increase in the number of firms and workers. The increase in taxes was largely financed through issuing more building permits, which led to higher urban revenues. To support the claim that building permits is a plausible mechanism which attracts more firms, in the face of higher taxes, we show that the positive impact of budget rules on employment growth and firms’ entry is concentrated in municipalities with no physical constraints to urban planning and development. (JEL D73, H72, R52, R31, R33)
abstract_zh: 我们利用1999年意大利政府对所有市级政府实施平衡预算财政规则、但2001年豁免5000人以下市镇的准自然实验，提供了市政预算规则对地方经济活动水平影响的准实验证据。受预算规则约束的市镇在增加税收的同时，企业数量和工人数量也显著增长。税收增长主要通过发放更多建筑许可证来弥补，这带来了更高的城市财政收入。为论证建筑许可是在税收增加背景下吸引更多企业的合理机制，我们证明预算规则对就业增长和企业进入的积极影响，集中体现在城市规划与发展不受物理条件限制的市镇。（JEL分类号：D73, H72, R52, R31, R33）
title: The effects of fiscal rules on building permits and economic activity: quasi-experimental evidence
title_zh: 财政规则对建筑许可和经济活动的影响：准实验证据
